decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - The windows formed in the northern elevation at first floor level shall be obscure or opaque glazed and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured material

Condition : 4 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period only expiring on 15 April 2004 when the buildings shall be removed and the site restored to its previous condition as hardstanding to the satisfaction of the Local Planing Authority.
description: Erection of 4 no temporary offices and ancillary parking to site.
